**collekt** is a library to facilitate spatio-temporal data collection across
arbitrary datasources.

## Getting started

```bash
uv sync --all-groups --all-extras
```

```python
import collekt

print(collekt.__version__)
```

See the [API reference](api/index.qmd) for the public API, and the
[implementation plan](plan.qmd) for the ongoing integration of the tb-rea core.
